content.bridge_context: Looking up at the night sky to understand our place in the universe, focusing on the moon, stars, and planets.

units.title: The Solar System
units.explanation: The sun and everything that travels around it, including eight planets.
units.dual_language_instruction: Which planet do we live on? / हम किस ग्रह पर रहते हैं?

units.title: Stars and Constellations
units.explanation: Stars are giant balls of hot gas; constellations are patterns of stars.
units.dual_language_instruction: Have you seen the 'Great Bear' (Saptarishi) in the sky? / क्या आपने आकाश में 'सप्तऋषि' को देखा है?
